info.sub_name: 大學基礎英文(一)中高級

description.sub_name: 大學基礎英文(一)中高級
description.describe_ch: 本課程分四級授課，採用不同素材，納入多元教學活動， 協助學生理解、賞析文本，建構自己的觀點，並與同儕分享、交流，以培養英語閱讀、口說、與聽力的基礎技能。
description.describe_eh: The course is divided into four levels. Different materials and diverse teaching activities were incorporated into course design to help students comprehend and appreciate texts, construct their own viewpoints, and communicate with their peers in order to develop basic skills in reading, speaking, and listening in English.

targets.describe_ch: 找到多元學習素材之主題，理解內容大意、分析重要細節及邏輯相關性。
targets.describe_en: In regard to the multiple learning materials, students can identify topics and themes, comprehend  gist, and analyze  important details and their logical relevance.

targets.describe_ch: 針對素材所呈現之主題，有效地表達自我想法，與他人進行溝通討論。
targets.describe_en: Students can effectively express their opinions on the themes of learning materials and communicate with others effectively.

targets.describe_ch: 藉由合作式學習，了解、尊重多元觀點的差異性，並培養團隊合作的能力。
targets.describe_en: Through collaborative learning, students can understand and respect diverse perspectives and learn to cooperate with other people in teams.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1. Be on time. 請準時上課。
2. Participate in the class discussion and class activities. 請參與課堂討論及課堂活動。
3. Students must submit a leave application to the school in advance, stating the reason for the leave and the expected duration.學生必須提前向學校提交請假申請，說明請假的原因和預計時間。
4. Please purchase original textbook, following intellectual property law. 請購買正版課本，請勿使用複製版本。
5. The texts and exercises will be completed in class. Please bring textbooks to class. 請上課攜帶課本，以利上課活動使用。
6. Follow the school rules to apply for a make-up exam within three days of the exam date. Relevant documents are required for the application. No-shows or those with late application will receive ZERO. The date of a make-up exam will be arranged by the instructor. 若須要補考的同學，請遵照學校的補考規定，在考試後的3天內提出申請。若考試當天沒有出現或者是沒有申請補考的同學，考試成績一律0分。
7. Following the FCU Exam Regulations, cheaters will receive ZERO for their exams and such cases will be reviewed by the Student Reward and Disciplinary Committee. 考試請遵照考場規定，若作弊者以0分計算。
8.本課程從109學年度起，廣泛閱讀的評分將主要依據Xreading系統所累進的字數而定。學生可與授課教師協調，以其他方式進行廣泛閱讀、檢核其學習成效，但進行方式須符合廣泛閱讀之精神並有客觀閱讀之事實。Starting from the 2020-2021 academic year, extensive reading (ER) will be mainly based on the word count accumulated on the Xreading platform over the semester. An alternative plan proposed by students, if approved by their teacher, may be acceptable. However, the alternative must be in compliance with the tenants of ER. Students need to present evidence to demonstrate that they have met the requirements as agreed to by their teachers.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 找到多元學習素材之主題，理解內容大意、分析重要細節及邏輯相關性。
courseBankC.describe_en: In regard to the multiple learning materials, students can identify topics and themes, comprehend  gist, and analyze  important details and their logical relevance.
courseBankC.core_item: 知識探索：能培養多元領域學習的興趣；能統整跨領域的知識；能持續從事跨領域的學習。
courseBankC.core_eng: Knowledge Pursuit：To integrate extensive interests, curiosities and literacy of multidisciplinary knowledge and internalize one’s won viewpoints.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 針對素材所呈現之主題，有效地表達自我想法，與他人進行溝通討論。
courseBankC.describe_en: Students can effectively express their opinions on the themes of learning materials and communicate with others effectively.
courseBankC.core_item: 溝通技巧：能具備清楚表達的能力；能理解他人口語與非口語的訊息；能建立良好的人際關係。
courseBankC.core_eng: Communication Skills：To be equipped with the skills of effective verbal and non-verbal  interaction  and team work communication.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 藉由合作式學習，了解、尊重多元觀點的差異性，並培養團隊合作的能力。
courseBankC.describe_en: Through collaborative learning, students can understand and respect diverse perspectives and learn to cooperate with other people in teams.
courseBankC.core_item: 價值判斷：能尊重多元價值；能進行價值的反思；能提出個人的價值判斷。
courseBankC.core_eng: Critical Thinking：To be equipped with multiple perspectives and tolerance of differences to identify problems, engage in reflective and critical thinking to resolutions.
